ablation.name: phase4g2b_per_subband_a05
ablation.notes: Phase 4G.2b: per_subband AdaIN with reduced scale. 4G.2 (alpha=1.0) achieved clip NEW SOTA 0.7361 but lpips FAIL 0.3843 (9x style injection from 9 independent full replacements). This experiment reduces endpoint_adain_scale to 0.5 (halving per-subband injection, ~4.5x total vs 4G.2 9x and 4F.1 1x). Goal: find sweet spot where per-subband precision (clip gain) coexists with content fidelity (lpips threshold <=0.3453). If PASS + clip>0.7319: new SOTA, paper Core Story upgraded. If FAIL: record as ablation, finalize paper with 4F.1 SOTA. Extreme value separation (0.5 vs 1.0) per user requirement.
